contracts.source: GlobalFoundries press release: GlobalFoundries and Monolithic Power Systems form (09-09-2026)
contracts.signal: GF and Monolithic Power Systems announced a long-term manufacturing agreement deploying MPS's proprietary process technology to GF's 300mm manufacturing facility in Singapore, expanding manufacturing capacity of MPS power management solutions in early 2027 (volume production in 2027). Products expected to be made there include next-generation power solutions for automotive architectures, industrial robotics and automation, and smart power stages for AI and cloud infrastructure. GF chief manufacturing officer Pradip Singh called it a long-term agreement; MPS EVP of global operations Deming Xiao cited improved supply assurance.
